name: mallet

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The mallet was a symbolic object. Several Celtic gods, especially Sucellus, carry a tool that resembles a hammer. Others carry a much larger tool, usually called a mallet. It is a type of bat whose phallic symbolism is evident. The Irish god Dagda was known for his enormous mallet, so large that he dragged it around on a wheeled cart.
objective: Document the mallet as a symbolic object carried by Celtic gods.
